og_title: Hackers broke into 25 real firewalls through the flaw, security firm says | Warning Shots
og_desc: The security firm Dream says files it recovered from an attacker show the PHP flaws chained with a Linux bug to take full control of 24 firewalls and a management server on Oct 23-24, two of them at a US government-affiliated organization. No victim, vendor or attacker is named and no victim has confirmed it, so this stays Proven, not Hit. America's cyber agency has listed the flaws as exploited since Oct 26. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 13 in a year. In 41% of this year's real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 164 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 27, 7:45 PM ET.
